description: This file defines an abstract base class 'TestlinkPlugin' for TestLink plugins, including properties for plugin metadata and methods for registration, initialization, installation, uninstallation, configuration, and hooks.

classes.name: TestlinkPlugin
classes.description: Abstract base class for creating TestLink plugins, establishing core properties and methods for plugin lifecycle management.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Abstract method to register the plugin, must set at least name and version.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initial setup for the plugin, including loading APIs and hooking events.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs plugin-specific installation activities, returns false to stop installation.

methods.name: hooks
methods.description: Defines hooks exposed by the plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database connection and registers the plugin.

methods.name: __init
methods.description: Final method to initialize plugin configuration and event hooks, then calls init().
